case: Disappearance of Ray Gricar (2005, Centre County, Pennsylvania)
angle: A sitting district attorney vanished after telling his girlfriend he was taking a scenic drive; his county laptop was later found in the Susquehanna River with the hard drive missing, and his home computer showed searches for 'how to wreck a hard drive' — but the underexposed reversal is that this same DA had declined to prosecute Jerry Sandusky in 1998.
